comment_clean: the curtains were all very dusty, the kitchen was not very clean and most pans are not compatible with the portable induction stove, the bathroom is serviceable but the shower is a bit of a nightmare on the account of it having a curtain instead of a normal glass door. the house overall is nice and well situated, bedrooms were clean.
Lovely flat very well situated. In a nice area very close to bars and restaurant. Could be a bit noisy at night.
It was really nice to stay with Joana, very uncomplicated. Perfect for a few days. Thank you!

The location of this Airbnb is perfect in Porto and I would recommend staying here. However some amenities listed are not present in the apartment such as the washing machine and the iron. There is also no cutlery so do not book expecting to be cooking your own meals. The apartment was clean and communication was great with the host. I would stay again.
The place was Nice just a problem with the high slope. If you intend to return on foot, be prepared for exercise.
Great apartment and location! We just had some noise issues in the apartment hallway and construction outside. Otherwise, great!

This is such a lovely home tucked into the historic streets of Porto. our host was so helpful and responsive. Our only recommendation is to clarify that laundry is in another nearby building and it is shared with other apartments. We wasted most of our first night finding it, waiting for it to be free, and then realizing it was a very long cycle. Otherwise we'd highly recommend this place!
small room but perfect for solotravelers, got help/answers quickly and felt really comfortable! extremely cheap for the place and kindness of the host.

Pretty little house near the sea, quiet and clean about 30 minutes by bus into the city. The only downside is that the bathroom is on the ground floor and the bedrooms upstairs which wouldn't be so much of an issue for some people if it wasn't for the very narrow spiral staircase. The area is lovely and it was nice to be away from the crowds of the city. The house is very well equipped and Joana is a kind and welcoming host.
Very nice, clean and comfortable apartment at good location, just 3 min walk from metro station. Even that it is not in a center of Porto, the neighborhood is nice. I would recommend it to anyone.
Lovely apartment in walking distance of all the main sightseeing. Inside you have all you need for a comfortable stay. Will choose it again.

Amazing location, spacious apartment, beautifully decorated! The only downside, it was hot! We knew there was no A/C and were hopping the Porto breeze would be enough to cool things down at night. Unfortunately being so close to the center means there was just too much noise to leave the windows open at night. We would definitely come back, but not during the summer.

We stayed in Ricardo’s apartment for 4 nights, mid summer. We received very clear instructions regarding our arrival and the communication was very smooth. The apartment was very clean; I couldn’t find any dirty dishes or something familiar. The view from the apartment was great and the neighbors were very friendly. The apartment has a great view but is located on a very steep hill, therefore I won’t recommend it for elder people. All in all, we had a amazing holiday and we keep dreaming of the incredible view from the balcony!
Perfect. Everything was great. Really nice flat, nice atmosphere. A bit noisy in the morning but Porto has to be seen anyway so not a problem at all! Very good location as well.

Amazing location and very good communication with the host. Lovely spacious studio and very clean. Quite loud at night with music playing in bar/restaurant below, it didn’t bother us at all as we can sleep through noise but just a heads up if you stay. The host always responded instantly and we had a fabulous time here, thank you!

Overall a good stay. Kitchen was stocked minimally. Very basic supplies (garbage bags, toilet paper) only lasted for a couple days then had to supply our own. Couple areas needed a deep clean. Quiet building, didn't really hear anyone around us. Lots of stairs, but a small elevator can be used. Decent area to get to transit. Would stay again.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Nuno's Airbnb in Gaia, Porto, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. The apartment was beautifully furnished and boasted magnificent views of the river and Porto skyline, offering an energetic atmosphere in the morning and a romantic ambiance at night. The location was perfect for exploring the vibrant city of Porto, with easy access to the main attractions, restaurants, and shopping areas. The apartment was well-equipped with all the necessary amenities, and the garage was spacious enough to accommodate my Mustang Mach E, making it a perfect choice for those traveling with larger vehicles. Nuno, our host, went above and beyond to ensure our stay was exceptional. He provided us with a plethora of invaluable recommendations, insider tips, and guidance to help us make the most of our visit. His attention to detail, genuine care, and warm hospitality truly enhanced our overall experience.
It is a nice place to stay, The bathroom and the toilet is in the room. It is separated but still looks to much. Apart that is a good place.

On arrival at the apartment the key hadn’t been left in the lockbox. After calling AirBnB and Portugal Active this was dealt with, but we were left outside for almost an hour. After a day of travelling this was less than ideal and unnecessarily stressful. The apartment was comfortable and in a good location. The outside space felt a little unloved - with some attention it could be a more pleasant place to be. We didn’t use the jacuzzi as we weren’t confident that it was ready for use. We loved Porto, it’s a great city.

The place was wonderful! We were greeted very nicely and given a nice tour of the apartment as well as suggestions for main sites to visit. The place was very nicely decorated (loved the tiling in the kitchen) with a very spacious patio! We were also given a nice bottle of red wine at our arrival. I would definitely recommend staying at this place! Location was great, and the walk into Porto (river side) was only around 30 minutes. Definitely want to come back to Helena's air bnb!!!

Thank you to all at Bloom apartments for making our first stay in Porto easy ! The guy ( maintenance) in the apartment was super friendly and very helpful ( thank you ) It’s a very busy area but wilt in the apartment the noise wasn’t too bad
Perfect place for a short stay. Exactly as described. The check-in was painless and simple.

Excellent location! Communication with the host was great, check in was great. The place was clean. Only thing I will point out is that the front room with the single bed is street facing,so it is slightly louder in there on a busy night. The main bedroom is very quiet though. I loved my stay!

We stayed at Mariana’s place for 10 days in November 2018. You cannot find a better place than this for any sense. It locates two minutes from the station São Bento by walk, right in the historical area in Porto. Apartment is stylish and spacious and very clean. Mariana was very caring. She helped us anytime we needed.
Great host, very responsive and easy to deal with. The apartment is awesome and the view to the river is AMAZING!!! I would highly recommend it.
Great place just a short walk to everything! The apartment had everything we needed including an elevator which was appreciated after hiking up that hill from Sao Bento! 🤣
Perfect location, you can go everywhere by walk. Also they are so nice everything was perfect, thanks for everything

Beautiful location to stay if you visit Porto! It was quite convenient to walk to locations that were on my bucket list, and take a stole around the strip every evening to watch the river! Very Safe neighborhood! Diana was such a lovely host, she responded quickly to messages and was very polite. Definitely will be staying here again next time I visit Porto!

Beautiful view, quiet neighbors. Downstairs there is subway and cars, with open windows can be a bit noisy, but the view and amenities in the apartment override everything. We had a good vacation here, we didn't want to go out
Patricia was a great host! The Apartment is cosy and beautiful. It is a bit noisy, being in the very centre of the city! We had a lovely time!
Nice and cosy flat, near to metro and bus station. Can be loud when the windows are open. Kitchen is very small but weel equiped.
Nice location. Loft is well equipped for small family. The loft is facing the street so could be a bit noisy.
Spacious apartment, close to everything. João was very responsive. Beds a little hard, but you get used to it.

The apartment is very centrally located and hence both very convenient and a bit noisy. The flat is well designed and has all you need for a short and nice stay. Maria is very reactive and provides the necessary support if needed.

The space is quite cozy and comfortable to stay in. The location is great as you're able to walk to a lot of great sightseeing areas. But it's also on a very busy road, so if you're a light sleeper, it's a bit though to get a good night's rest. The apartment was spotless and the host was very helpful.
The place is centrally located, with a very chic design and pleasant furnishings. It was a very nice stay and definitely my choice when i will come back to Porto.
It was a nice stay. Rooms are okay, nothing special, but cozy :) The only bad thing is that there was no kettle in the apartment.
Great location & a decent space to base yourself in Porto. The room was a bit noisy as others have mentioned but it didn’t keep us awake. The check in was easy and communication was clear.

Sadly the intetnet didn't worked or was incredible weak to the point that it wouldn't even load messages and they did nothing about it. Also please be aware the hot water lasts very little and even with the air conditioner on he's not enough for the whole place and it's a bit cold. Also theres no curtains so if you want daily light people can see you from other windows. The bathroom also lacks a place inside the bath area to put our personal cleaning amenities. If you come witu a big bag the entry door is small and there's no elevator
A little noisy late at night due to nearby venue playing very loud music until 1am. General decor in need of freshening up.
Everything was perfect – no problems at all. Great communication with the host and I would definitely recommend this place!

We came to Porto for two sailing championships. We were a group of 7 people. The house was conveniently located between the two clubs, both of which were about a 10-15 minute drive away. The house was spacious and comfortable. It had all the amenities we needed. We appreciate the host getting us a new dryer when we informed her that the other one was not working. She also quickly got the air conditioner to work in one of the bedrooms that also wasn't working when we first arrived. The location of the house was very good. It was a pleasant walk to the beach or to the park, and the neighborhood was nice. All in all, the house was the perfect fit for our needs.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is very clean and modern, beautifully decorated, and well-organized. The kitchen was fully equipped with all the necessary utensils. Distance is probably 10-15mins walk to the main of Porto and great restaurants. I highly recommend!

Great place for a short stay in Porto! The apartment is clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything you might need. It’s conveniently located – just a 15-minute walk to the city center, very close to the metro, and there’s a supermarket nearby. We also had no trouble finding parking in the area. The only minor downside is a small bar on the corner – it can get a bit noisy at night when locals gather for drinks. But it didn’t spoil our overall experience. All in all, a great base for exploring Porto. Would recommend for a short stay!

Very good location, close to a central square at the river area. Street was noisy due to the summer festival that was going on but we knew this based on other reviews. Carlos was very helpful at check giving us suggestions for what to do, and answered questions that we had. We were able to store our luggage prior to the check in.

Carlos was a great host and a tremendous help to us. We appreciate all he did. Carlos is the host with the most charming and fun personality, as well as being highly articulate! Carlos has made two friends for life! If you truly want the feel and personality of Portugal, this quaint little area offers you the best; small cobblestone streets, charming little shops, with access to larger malls that gives you the best shopping and a short tram ride to downtown Porto and the best restaurants in this area. Lots of beautiful and friendly people are waiting to meet you. The apartment has everything you need whether you are staying two nights or a few months. Enjoy your stay in beautiful Porto, Portugal - we did!
We loved our stay here, Augusto is an incredible host and the place was immaculate! It's in a fantastic location, we would definitely come back

Beautiful place, clean, exactly as described, and centrally located to all the popular spots yet was still quiet at night. Daniel was also very responsive and offered a very helpful guide of Porto. Highly recommend!

This is a good place to crash for a night. Beware that even though there is no AC (as they said), there is no fan either, and the apartment can get very hot! You also may want to bring your own pillow… With that said, the location is AMAZING! You are just steps from everything in Porto, and the hosts were very kind. For a night, maybe a weekend if you are on the go, this place is a great value for the cost.
We found the location very handy with lots of restaurants and bars nearby. The home was very clean and we had a good night sleep.

I stayed here with two friends and had a great time - the apartment is beautiful with tall ceilings and nicely furnished. It’s in a good location for visiting everywhere on foot. The team were really responsive and also were very helpful with organising a taxi to pick us up from the airport late at night. I’d definitely stay here again and would recommend.

excellent place to stay if you are visiting Porto. very nice and clean rooms, lots of privacy when you want it, and located in a quiet area with very quick walking access to good restaurants and attractions

It’s a good place, you can walk surround the neighborhood, it’s not too close to the main center but easy to get there, the bed was uncomfortable with annoyed sounds while you’re moving, much better the sofa bed, the internet was super fast, you have to buy your own flame lighter otherwise you cannot cook

Manuela's place was more run down than what the pictures show, including some dirty walls. Biggest problem was the distance from the center of town. It says in the ad that it is a 20 minute walk to the center of town, when it is really a 45 minute walk. We left one day early because of this.

Wonderful place! Ana greeted us in person, showed us the apartment and told us a bit about the history of the house. We got some tips for nearby restaurants and bars. We felt very welcome! The apartment itself is beautiful and perfect for 2 people. We would come back there anytime!
the place is very well located and has a beautiful garden. it has basic things but some other essesntial things that are usually expected at an airbnb, toilet paper, shampoos and coffee ect. .
Great location, nice shower and a welcoming host! The walls were a bit thin but other than that I had a great stay.

Very nice apartment that fits the pictures perfectly. Jose welcomed us personally with a precise introduction, he was very considerate and we felt very welcome in the apartment. Only minus is noise from the big street nearby. The windows take most of the noise but light sleepers should maybe bring ear plugs :)

The apartment was located up a narrow lane close to the main road along the river. Nice restaurants, a bakery, a pharmacy, medical clinic and grocery nearby. You should know that there is a large flight of stairs to get up to it. Plus there were no instructions or information for any of the appliances or for the area. The apartment was comfortable, beds were nice. But, the attached house next door was being renovated/demolished so the noise during the day was rather annoying.

The house is small but nice, quiet and extremely clean. We had a great time there. The only difficulty is to go to the city center by public transport (bus is very infrequent and the ferry to cross the river is expensive), however Uber works perfectly and is even cheaper than the bus for 4 people.

Joaquim is a caring host who takes great care of his home and made me feel very comfortable and at ease. The bed and bedding are very comfy and no street or car noise so I slept very well even with windows open. He even gave me free coffee and toast for breakfast through his coffee shop just around the corner. The food gave me strength to ride to my next Camino destination. Thank you for being so kind and caring!
We had a good time at Adriana’s apartment despite the fact that the apartment is very noisy because of the road beside. I recommend anyway

We had a wonderful time in Porto, staying in this marvelous apartment which is in a very central location. Mariana was very responsive. Nothing to do with the host but a central location does come with some street news which was expected and didn’t bother us. We would stay here again.

It was all very good at this place. The only problems were that the bathroom smelled very strongly of humidity and that when you showered, too much water would spill out of the shower floor, wetting the bathroom floor. All the rest was impeccable.
very cool location to live in Porto. quiet and also close to center. we loved the way to home, everyday something different and beautiful.

The apartment was smaller than we thought, but it had everything we need. It is very clean, beautiful and well equipped. Unfortunately, at the time of our stay there was a construction site on the street in front of the apartment, which made it a bit noisy. We still had a nice stay there.

All went well during our 3 nite stay, very quiet building & lovely view over the river & sunset. Used the bikes provided and had easy ride into the Ribeira which was great considering the traffic & people there. Our host was very accommodating & recommended some restaurants for us, thank you João!!

Fantastic place to stay! Felt like a home away from home. But what made this stay extra special were the hosts. Joaquim actually picked us up from the airport after our transatlantic flight, gave us a tour of Contumil and kindly dropped us off at the city center since we wanted to explore downtown. Excellent communication between us and Joaquim and his daughter, Patricia, who is fluent in English. Every morning, Joaquim brought us fresh bread and pastries. Not to mention the fresh eggs (Joaquim has chickens) and lettuce and fruit Joaquim grows organically (he welcomed us to take whatever we needed from his little farm) What can I say - the hosts are just genuine, down-to-earth, kind, compassionate souls. We are so pleased that we will be ending our stay in Portugal with 2 last nights at Joaquim's place after our travels in beautiful Portugal.
Check in was a bit of wait about half hour to get the keys and one of the key door was not the right one. Otherwise, everything was excellent.

Teresa’s place is great. It has a perfect location and is walking distance to the main touristic attractions in Porto. Teresa is also a great host and made pas minute arrangements for us to arrive in the middle of the night because our plane was so delayed. Definitely recommend staying here.

We loved our stay here! You are walking distance to great spots to eat and hang out. We were there in the winter so the space heater upstairs was great. The apartment is a duplex. Please note the bedroom is up the stairs and the bathroom is down the stairs. The living space is very stylish and modern. The apartment is very clean. Also note that the apartment is on the first floor near the front door.

It was a nice apartment, good location with lots of resturants around. Only thing that bothered me was that on Friday and Saturday there was loud music that started playing around midnight somewhere around that we heard well in the apartment.

Beautiful schist village, situated right above the river. The house was cozy and well outfitted. Very quiet and peaceful in the winter. Isabel sent us great recommendations, and was always responsive. It is a little remote, but you are a 15 minute drive to the beautiful village of Alvarenga, where you can get all of your supplies. Very close to the suspension bridge as well. Beautiful area for hiking and relaxation.

Really loved the apartment. Big in size and went with two small kids. Joana provided cot bed and high chair for the kids. The apartment has got everything you can think of and it’s close to the beach , restaurants, supermarkets and nice shops. You can reach the centre of Porto by bus. Really enjoyed our stay there. Thank you Joana !

Nice and cosy place though have to walk up many flight of stairs in the apartment. The many flight of stairs will be tough for the elderly, those with knee problems and those that have heavy and big luggage. On the whole, the place is within walking distance from most place of interests.

Very cosy flat right in the middle of the town. It's sparky clean and has everything you need. The bed is very comfortable. We were really pleased with the fast check in and all the recommendations we received from the hosts. Fantastic experience! Hope to be back again. Thank you.
It's a nice place, new and mordem. The equipments are good and comfortable bed to sleep! It's a nice choice!

We had a lovely stay in beautiful Porto in Late June/early July. Sonia's apartment was a great find. A spacious 3 bed apartment, beautifully decorated with everything as described. A very short walk to the train and local shops made it an ideal location, near but far enough from the centre which meant there was little noise at night and not much early morning traffic outside either. The only negatives we would have with Sonias place would be: 1. the beds were not very comfortable. 2. As it was very hot when we were there, an air conditioning system would have been lovely. There were fans in each bedroom but they were noisy at night. Otherwise we had a lovely stay and found Sonia, very helpful and contactable at short notice. A lovely visit!
Great flat, but the location was poor, too far away, looks a bit rough in that area. definitely get an uber on the night

Great apartment - spacious, well-designed and located in a quiet, pleasant neighborhood about a 20-minute walk from all the key spots in the city. Even though there’s no AC, it stayed comfortable inside thanks to the fans and dehumidifier. Having two bathrooms was also super convenient. Would definitely recommend!

My friend and I stayed for 4 nights in this great apartment. The communication went all very well. It was very clean, cosy, spacious and all in all, a great experience. We loved the great design and the location just around the corner of sights, bakeries and restaurants. We can very much recommend this place.

The house is beautiful, the bed and the pillows were very comfortable. Very clean and quiet place but! The internet was shit and the connection inacceptable!!! There were problems some times with the water and the dishwasher seems not to work very well. There were lot of flies and mosquitoes. We were not really happy with the place.

It's ok to stay for 1 night, would advise to fix air conditioning as bit hot. I understand that it was mentioned that there is no air conditioning, but if you open windows, then it becomes very noisy. Otherwise good place.

The apartment was clean and conveniently located near all the attractions in the very center of Porto. But most of all I'd like to highlight the exceptional manager, Helena. She was always available and responded quickly to all my requests. She was very kind and ready to help. Helena, it was a grest pleasure meeting you!

Lovely little apartment with an outdoor space - nice to have for our week long stay, perfect space for 2. Not in the middle of the city centre but very accessible by walking. Our host Giovanna was very friendly in meeting us. Some damage to the bedroom wall upon arrival which wasn’t an issue, all in all a lovely stay and would happily return :)
The host responds very quickly and the place is clean and tidy, but it's very noisy throughout the day and night.

I really enjoyed my time there! The apartment was very nice and super comfortable and cozy. It had everything I could possibly need. They asked me everyday if I wanted my room/apartment clean. Every time I told them yes, they left the room completely spotless to the same level I got when I first arrived on my very first day. I was very impressed with the level of commitment they have with making the guest experience pleasant and easy. I have no problem recommending this place and I will definitely keep it in mind for my next visit to Porto.

Rien à dire. Everything was as described, and Fernando (Rita's dad) is the best host you could hope for. He was very responsive and helpful throughout all our stay. The place was super clean, and the location was very convenient (bus stops everywhere around to go to the city or elsewhere). Bonus: Fernando speaks very good French. All in all, it was great.

The unit looks more beautiful and spacious than in the photos published. You have everything that you need for a traveler like us. The heating was working nicely. As an Asian, this is also the first time I used a European style bathroom/bidet and it was helpful for my bathroom needs. The room is not that soundproof though so you can hear footstep noises upstairs and some talking voices etc from the other room. Pedro's parents who welcomed us are also very kind, polite and made sure we have everything.

Apartment is great for a long weekend. Compact in size but perfect for a couple getting away. Location is good and just a short walk from everything you require. We did have some issues with the bathroom which José said he would address. Would certainly recommend.
Miguel was very friendly, responsive and willing to help. He even allowed me to check-in early and made sure everything was going smooth for me.

Adriana’s place was exactly as described and a perfect position for Porto. While it was close to restaurants and bars it was still quiet in the apartment. If we were to return to Porto, we would certainly stay there again.

Excellent location and communication! Very quiet and clean. Comfortable bed. Didn't see a washing machine in the apartment but perhaps there is a shared one somewhere in the building. Highly recommend this place.

Look no further if you are looking for the perfect place to stay near the beach and with easy access to Old Town in Porto. The apartment is very clean, comfortable for two and close to both restaurants and grocery stores. The 500 bus was easy to catch and took us right to the center of town. Ricardo and Andreia are the perfect host. This was our first time in Portugal and they provided us with all the information needed to navigate public transportation, fado music options and even researched gluten free dining options in the area, all of which are now listed on their postings. Thank you so much for a wonderful first visit. We would easily choose to stay here again.
This is an outstanding, beautiful period apartment and is situated on the edge of the central area of Porto. As described it was quiet. It was a great stay and a very responsive host.
Walking distance to the river and tourist spots and yet it was wonderful and quiet. The beds were divine and everything else was lovely and clean and comfortable.

It's pretty good！it's the most beautiful hotel i lived before！The garden，the living room，the bedroom and the breakfast are really perfect！So herevyou just need to enjoy your time because the service is pretty good！I must recommend my friends come here next time！I will come back next time！
This apartment was wonderful! Great location and size. As people describe, there is street noise. We luckily brought ear plugs and had no trouble sleeping.
It was a pleasure to stay in this apartment! Minimalist but very functional and elegant design. Thanks for the good responsiveness.
It is close to the center, smelled great, had kitchen equipment. The host was very helpful and friendly, I’d recommend it to couples!
all great, except one guy came without notice to fix the thermostat. No notice AT ALL, just went into de apartment when mi girlfriend was alone in there and he didn't even speak English. scary

Really convenient place to stay to enjoy Porto. Simple and nice and just like the pictures. Only be aware there is a road nearby that is a little loud if you are a light sleeper. Everything you need to be self sufficient and good advice on where to eat. The restaurant underneath (Brazilian) is good and very reasonable - best banana jam desert!
Nice clean place. Carlos is so friendly and helpful. The bed was a bit of cheap kind and made some noises. Not a big deal since Carlos said that he is replacing it with a better one soon.
Nice place but sofa bed was a little uncomfortable and living room was nonexistent when the sofa bed was out

Elsa's place was spacious and clean and the location can't be beat. Very walkable and metro and bus only a short 2min walk. Elsa is a great host and very welcoming. She also has great local recommendations.

The ac was broke when arrived and reported. Not only that it leaked all over our things. I reported to host immediately. The host failed to resolve the issue instead offering us to cancel and find another place, 8.20pm night we arrived with two kids after 3 hour drive! Not helpful. Then the host proceeded to blame us for turning the ac on then contacted us the day later, and because I waited 15 minutes to respond, as we were sought seeing, the whole reason we went to Porto, she said as I didn’t reply shr cancelled technician. I then gave authorisation for the technician to come day 3 ( still no ac) she then didn’t respond to any of my messages. Totally unprofessional and unacceptable given the temperature were 30 degrees and it’s a small upstairs apartment. I would strongly advise against anyone staying here, the host is impolite and unhelpful and rude

It was a wonderful stay, very close to the downtown, very close to public transportation and several restaurants around. The communication with the host were fluid and responsive. The apartment was exactly as the picture, definitely we’ll be back.

Great little apartment for exploring Porto - the neighbourhood is convenient for travel to/from Lisbon and the airport and there are lots of great places to eat and drink nearby - we enjoyed Idiota and Aduela Bar. The apartment is really cosy and well decorated and the balcony is great - really enjoyed it. Thanks.
WARNING - DO NOT BOOK! Unit is described as a two bedroom apartment, but it only has one bed! When we messaged the airbnb host about the issue, he just ghosted us and stopped responding!
Nice place, lovely location but the bedroom does not have a door and leads into the living area where the third person is staying.
The only negative was being on the 3rd floor and no lift, quite an effort to get your bags up. Otherwise apartment was great, well located and everything you need

I can highly recommend Martha's accommodation.. friendly reception.. absolutely clean.. if I had any questions, she was always ready to help me.. and proper duvets.. 10 minutes to the train that goes to the old town... Next time in Porto I will definitely book with Martha again...

The stay is very next to Porto old town. Most of the highlights were walkable distance away. The apartment is as described. + very close to old town + access to supermarket + private covered parking + responsive host + welcome with a bottle of wine:) Neutral: old apartment building with lot of keys (counted 6 and used 5). Front door, apartment door,lift to parking lot. Parking lot entry. - parking lot is right next to a pillar and a bit tight to enter with remote doors which closes very fast. Need expert driving skill to park - the oven was not working and the moment we turned on to grill something entire power to the apartment was lost. The fuse tripped. Reported it and Hopefully they fix it soon. Suggestion : They still could do with a curtain to go with the rollers.

This is awesomw house. It has TV, loats of species so you can cook your own food. It even has coffee, which is trully cool. Also, restaurant exaclty in the same building. It's really comfy and cool. Thx a lot :)
Great location but if you are in the centre of Porto you need to be aware it will be noisy. We had a fabulous time. A lovely city to visit and enjoy yourself.
This place was fantastic! Perfect in every way. My family stayed here 3days. If I could give this place 10 stars I would.
Great location. Close to the river and some tucked away restaurants. The only thing we were lacking was WiFi so my son could do his online schooling.
The flat was perfect. Clean and looked like the pictures! Easy self check in and out!

The room and bathroom were clean and welcoming. With no kitchen, they served a small but adequate breakfast every morning, which we enjoyed. However, it was clear when we tried to contact the host on the Airbnb app that we were talking with an AI, which gave us contradictory answers to our questions and was not very helpful when we asked for accomodations. It also meant there was no flexibility around check in/out or leaving bags. Overall a nice space, even if the road outside was quite noisy, but felt more like a hotel. Easy access to metro so getting into town was fine, and for what we paid, it did the trick nicely. Would only recommend for shorter stays, but happy with our stay.

Pedro’s place is very cute and cozy. Nice sunny balcony for a coffee with side views to the river and access through a typical ribeira back street where time seems to have stoped. The flat had everything needed for a few days (at least for me) and it was well cleaned. Being in ribeira area, it’s very close to the river side but it is an uphill walk to the city centre, a nice one if you don’t mind walking. There are restaurants, bars and shops around. Only critic is that some details need attention as things get worn out! Overall 👌

Thank you so much Pedro! He was the best host we’ve ever met ! He sent me loads of recommendations and links and he was always so quick to respond to me. His place is honestly much better and more spacious than it looks in the photos. We will 100% come back and stay at his airbnb again <3

Great location, only wish.the the place had an AC unit. We had to keep the windows open and the bar down the street was noisy. It's a great location, public parking close by as well as tourist attractions.

The best thing about this apartment is the proximity to the river beach- if you like to swim (which our family do) and see Porto then this is the place for you! Unfortunately amenities e.g shop, restaurants and public transport were not close by. Taxis did come promptly and we're not pricey, however. I would also say that the flat felt small for 5 people, probably better for 3 or 4. The balconies are very nice and the neighbourhood is quite peaceful and traditional.
Great modern apartment in a superb location. Lovely balcony with a peaceful atmosphere, right in the heart of the city. Everything you need for a stay in Porto.

Beautiful and quiet apartment in one of the best locations in Porto, great restaurants, bars, bakeries and coffee shops nearby. Checking in and out was easy, and we walked pretty much everywhere. Everything is brand-new. The only downsides are that the AC doesn't reach the bed area (I asked if they had a fan but no one replied), and the steep angle of the staircase. We'd stay there again.

What a great flat! Super clean! Great view from the bedroom balcony. Comfortable living room and kitchen. 2 minute walk from the flat to the beach. Nuno was a very accommodating host! Whenever we needed help, he was ready to help us. 100% would recommend!

The apartment is near the metro station. And you will get the metro every five minutes. One bedroom with a private bathroom and essential accessories made our stay way more comfortable. The host is very helpful.

Fantastic stay. Apartment was super modern, clean and in the best location. Very quiet considering the hustle and bustle outside. Amazing to leave the apartment and be in an area packed with everything you need. Kudos to Luís' co-host Antonio, who helped when we really needed it. All in all, you can't go wrong with this one.
Fabio´s flat was very clean and very good located. It was a good choice. The only disadvantage was a noise in the building (doors, elevator) and from outside.

Very cute place, the only problem is that the house can be very cold because of poor heating. The water in the shower gets suddenly cold after ten minutes of using it and you have to wait hours for it to become warm again. Other than that, it is a very cute place with a nice position.

Great little flat perfect for a couple and really well located just a 10 minute walk into town along Rua Santa Catarina. Place was absolutely spotless and communication with Liliana easy and quick - highly recommended.

We stayed for 10 days and enjoyed every one of them. The location is perfect and the view unbeatable. The loft was exactly as described and very clean. The check-in and response to any of our needs was immediate. Would not hesitate to recommend it to any of our family or friends and definitely try to stay in this loft again when in town.
Amazing location. Apartment is simple and very spacious. It’s true what other reviews said about the smell- in the morning it was strong - but it was only a night, so no problem.
Wished we stayed longer! This place was so comfortable and clean, and a great quiet location close to the action.
It is quite noisy, the sunsets are gorgeous but the view is not of a park- but tenements.

The apartment is nice but it seemed to me that the construction work had not yet been completed. There was hair under the bathroom cabinet, a wire coming from the street was tangled next to the bed as if it were an unfinished construction, a hole next to the exhaust fan and no curtains, since there are other apartments facing it less than 3 meters away, I felt like I had no privacy, something that could have been solved cheaply. For the price that was charged, I expected more.

Teresa’s apartment space is simple and pleasant. The no-frills apartment does just the trick when you need a place to stay that is in the city and close to great transportation! Teresa greeted us at the building in a timely manner, showed us the place, and gave us great local tips. I recommend this place for anyone needing a nice landing pad in Porto. Thanks again, Teresa!

Pedro & Leonor’s “sewing apartment” is one of the nicest places we have ever stayed in! I would very much recommend it to anyone. The building is beautifully designed, the flat is decorated with so much taste and attention to detail and the garden is like a little oasis within the city of Porto. Petro & Leonor are wonderful hosts. We felt very welcome and at home and will definitely come back.
A very nice place. Just a little away from City center, but with a lot of space for parking a car. Very clean. Luis and his wife are lovely.

I can't say enough about Enrico, his family, his Airbnb and his VERY Delicious food. This establishment is run by Enrico, his wife and their two sons. They are the absolute sweetest people you will ever meet. They were very knowledgeable and helpful when planning our daily excursions. Coming for a loving family, I felt right at home. Most notable of our experience was the food. The room comes with a breakfast which consists of fresh squeezed juices, homemade yogurt, fresh baked breads, delicious meats/cheeses and coffee. More importantly, you should make time for the dinners that are served in the evening time. I've spent many years in the restaurant industry and the food being served at Vila Camila is TOP NOTCH. If I find myself back in Porto, I will definitely stay in this wonderful establishment. Thank you for a memorable experience!
Great place to stay in Porto, there are everything you need in this appartement and it was a very great location close to the center ! Would recommend it
Would be amazing to have a small air conditionning in the house. Very hot if you keep the windows closed, but a lot of noise until late at night due to the location. But overall very nice stay!

Fantastic apartment! From the moment we arrived, we felt right at home. The apartment was fully equipped with everything we needed. The location is ideal, just steps away from great restaurants, bars, and nightlife. The balcony overlooks a lively terrace, where music plays in the evenings, which we didn’t mind at all. Overall, we couldn’t be happier with our stay. Highly recommended!
Nice and courteous hosts. The cleaning ladies were super sweet and did a great job. All in all very positive experience.

Location great. Cleaning could be done better, the previous guest's dirty sheets had been left in the stairwell which was not very pleasant.. Showers quite dirty too. Good place for a bigger group, nice, big terrace and as i said, the location is perfect just next to jardím do Morro.

Everything went great. Nice and cosy apartment. The flexible check in made our lives so much easier! Jin was very nice and a great help. The bed was a bit too hard, but this was the only negative thing I could think of. Definitely recommend!

We had a great time at Dayanador's apartment. It is in a fantastic location, literally opposite the metro station directly from the airport, within a few minutes' walk to Porto centre, has a lift, is well equipped (enough crockery to actually cook, a rare find!) and very clean. Very much recommended!

Our stay at Andreia’s was okay, her apartment is in a very central location and it was easy to walk nearly anywhere. Andreia was a very responsive host and was available to help us when we had questions. However, the apartment was filled with many smells covered up by air fresheners (the bedroom smelled of mold, the fridge smelled of fish, etc.), it made it difficult to enjoy spending time at the airbnb. Another thing to note is the small hot water tank, we could only get through one very quick shower before running out of hot water. Also, the bed is very soft and the sheets are clearly very old and used which was not the most enjoyable. We did also have a situation where the breaker jumped from having too many things run at once, Andreia was helpful in getting this fixed but something to keep in mind.

Had an amazing stay for a solo female traveler who wanted to have a quiet, private and convenient place during 4 days in Porto. The apartment is well-equipped with everything you need, very responsive host and I did sleep very well. Thank you so much and I would love to stay here once again if I ever come visit Porto in the future :) Highly recommended!
Perfect location to everything. Our spot was quiet with beautiful rooftops views. Our teenager enjoyed having the pullout for his space. Very clean and comfortable.
